correctness.rationale: The original coordinate relay fusion frame is Parseval by the exact identity \(\sum_i|\langle f,e_i\rangle|^2=\|f\|^2\). Each chosen local frame has operator \(S_i=iI\), and the local-dual energy is exactly \(\sum_i|\langle f,e_i\rangle|^2/i^2\), whose value on \(e_n\) is \(1/n^2\); hence no positive lower bound exists. The repaired estimates follow from \(\|S_i^{-1}y\|\in[\|y\|/\|S_i\|,\|S_i^{-1}\|\|y\|]\) and summation. No finite experiment is used.

value.rationale: The local relay dual is one of the source paper's advertised new duality constructions. The counterexample shows that this construction can fail even for a Parseval RFF with one-dimensional relay spaces, so the issue is structural rather than high-dimensional. The repair identifies the exact missing mechanism in the proof and gives explicit quantitative bounds; in the scalar coordinate model the uniform two-sided condition is also necessary.
